source_text: Notable controversies include disparities in nomenclature and policy application—such as framing female genital cutting as mutilation while viewing male circumcision as neutral or beneficial—and the influence of institutional biases, where advocacy for the practice may prioritize collective health modeling over individual rights assessments.
